body:
Autrone Tinkerer
CR 16

An autrone tinterer is a towering mechanical figure. Its spherical central body hums with energy, gears and pistons whirring in a symphony of precision. Five slender, articulated limbs extend from its form, each ending in sharp, claw-like appendages. Bright orange eyes scan the surroundings with a sapient awareness. The air crackles with the latent power of its inventions strapped about its body, and you can feel the weight of its presence, a blend of ancient technology and relentless purpose.

XP 76,800
Autrone Tinkerer 16
LN Large Construct (Aberration)
Init +1; Senses Low-light vision, darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +16

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 10, flat-footed 12 (+1 Dex, +4 natural, -1 size, -1 size)
hp 144 (16d6+48)
Fort +13, Ref +11, Will +12
Defensive Abilities Aberrant Construction, energy resistance (Cold, Fire, Electricity) 20, Immune to disease, mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, sleep, precision-based damage

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee Unarmed strike +16/+11/+6/+6/+6 (1d4+4)
Ranged Arcane Blaster +13/+8/+3 (1d8 force+1d6 fire) 19-20 ×3
Special Attacks Integrated Flamethrower (2d4 fire, 15- ft. cone, Reflex DC 19 half, 1 + Con modifier/day)

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 12, Con 16, Int 22, Wis 10, Cha 8
Base Atk +12; CMB +18, CMD 30 (+6 versus trip)
Feats Armor Plating (taken twice), Bitron Upgrade, Enhanced Vision Lenses, Integrated Flamethrower, Quintatron Upgrade, Rapid Reassembly, Tangible Innovation, Tetratron Upgrade
Skills Craft (Alchemy) +25, Craft (Engineering) +25, Disable Device +20, Knowledge (Arcana) +25, Knowledge (Engineering) +25, Perception +16, Spellcraft +25, Use Magic Device +18
Languages Common, Autrone, Icosian, Aquan, Terran
SQ Autrone Telepathy, Craft Invention, Expanded Innovation Capacity +4, Fix Anything, Jury Rigger, Quick Reconfiguration (3/day), Wondrous Inventions, Dweomer Reassembly, Arcane Overload

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Craft Invention (Ex)

The tinkerer can assemble a certain number of inventions per day, modified with Innovation Points (IP).

Jury Rigger (Ex)

The tinkerer can Craft items faster and without penalties for not having appropriate tools.

Expanded Innovation Capacity (Ex)

The tinkerer can increase the IP limit of a single item by 4 points.

Quick Reconfiguration (Su)

The tinkerer can Disassemble and reassemble inventions twice per day.

Wondrous Inventions (Su)

The tinkerer can Craft magic items using class level as caster level, substituting Use Magic Device checks for required spells.

Fix Anything (Ex)

The tinkerer can restore broken or sundered magical items.

Dweomer Reassembly (Su)

The tinkerer can restore items with removed magical properties.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Organization Solitary or with other Autrones
Treasure Standard

Inventions
Arcane Blaster: Ranged weapon that deals 1d8 force damage and 1d6 fire damage, with an increased range of 50 feet.
Flame Thrower: Emits a cone of fire that deals 1d6 fire damage and 1d4 acid damage in a 20-foot cone.
Force Field Emitter: Grants 1d10 + Int modifier temporary hit points, adds DR 5/magic.
Healing Injector: Heals 1d8 hit points, adds 1d4 temporary hit points, and removes one condition (dazed, fatigued, or sickened).
Portable Alchemy Lab: Creates alchemical items in half the normal time, grants +2 bonus to Craft (Alchemy) checks, increases the number of alchemical items created by 50%, and allows creation without raw materials (up to 10 gp value).
Speed Booster: Grants +20 feet to movement speed for 2 minutes and allows an additional move action for 1 round.
